origin.description: Find where each value first occurs in a table.
origin.usage: fmatch(x, table, nomatch = NA_integer_, incomparables = NULL)

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Returned when a value is absent. It is coerced to integer.

arguments.name: incomparables
arguments.text: Anything other than NULL or a single FALSE is handed to match().

origin.details: Integer, real, and character tables are hashed. A real NA does not match a NaN, and -0 matches 0. A factor being looked up is matched by its labels. A factor table is matched by its integer codes, so the character "a" does not match a factor level "a". Other types, and any other incomparables value, warn and use match().
origin.value: Integer positions, one per lookup value. A miss is nomatch.
origin.example: cat(fmatch(c(1, NA, NaN, 0), c(0, NA, NaN)), "\n")
